KISWAHILI — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi.
